title: Spanish court investigates Julio Iglesias over sexual abuse claims
summary_full: Case involving allegations from two women employed at singer’s properties in Caribbean had been shelvedA Spanish court is investigating the singer Julio Iglesias over complaints that he sexually abused and physically assaulted two female employees who worked at his properties in the Caribbean.The announcement of the investigation by the Audiencia Nacional comes almost 11 months after Spanish prosecutors shelved the women’s complaints, arguing the country’s courts had no jurisdiction as the alleged offences took place outside Spain.
